DAMAGE_REQUEST: optional ToughnessCommitContext for selected normal stance only
REMOVE_MODIFIER: target resolution or explicit callback ModifierInstance identity
SET_DYNAMIC_VALUE: DynamicValue key/value inputs or selected state read

selected ModifierOwnerEntity SurvivalState.max_hp; ParamEntity/ParamEntity2/SnapshotPropertyEntity RuntimeEntity.attack; or Caster/SnapshotPropertyEntity RuntimeEntity.break_damage_added_ratio for SetDynamicValueByProperty

missing_context_policy: SemanticExecutor raises SemanticExecutionError when a selected operation is invoked without its declared scenario/context input; no handler supplies fixture defaults.
